summary: Accelerant Holdings, a Cayman Islands exempted company listed on the NYSE, filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive merger agreement with Cherry Tree BidCo and its wholly owned subsidiary Merger Sub, affiliates of Thoma Bravo Discover Fund V, L.P. The transaction is a going-private merger: Merger Sub will merge with and into Accelerant, with Accelerant surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. The Company's board, based on the unanimous recommendation of a special committee of independent and disinterested directors, approved the merger as fair and in the best interests of shareholders and will recommend approval at a shareholder meeting. Upon consummation, Class A common shares will be delisted from the NYSE and deregistered under the Exchange Act. The filing notes the effect on capital stock for both Class A and Class B common shares. What to watch: shareholder vote, closing conditions, regulatory approvals, and any dissenters' rights; risk-arb angle focuses on deal spread and timeline.
